title: 公園用滑り台
description: 連続した曲面の滑走部、立ち上がった側面、踊り場、はしご、手すり、支持脚を備える静的な滑り台。安全規格適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static slide with continuous curved chute, raised sides, platform, ladder, handrails and connected supports. Safety-standard compliance has not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
